title: Delivery, Haul-Away and Return Concessions by Northbeam Circle Tier
content:
## Concessions a Circle tier carries on delivery and on goods coming back

These are the delivery, haul-away and return concessions recorded for each tier of Northbeam Circle
Membership. The delivery threshold is the order value at or above which standard delivery is free. The
haul-away figure is the appliance haul-aways included each membership year. The extra return days are
added to the published return window. The waiver share is the part of a restocking fee waived for the
member, as a percentage. The review threshold is the number of returns in a rolling year beyond which
the membership is reviewed for abuse.

| Tier | Free standard delivery at or above (USD) | Haul-aways included per year | Extra return days | Restocking fee waived (percent) | Returns before review (rolling year) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Circle Free Membership | 499.00 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 8 |
| Circle Plus Annual | 199.00 | 1 | 15 | 25 | 12 |
| Circle Total Annual | 0.00 | 4 | 45 | 100 | 20 |
| Circle Total Household Annual | 0.00 | 6 | 45 | 100 | 24 |
| Circle Business Pro | 0.00 | 12 | 30 | 50 | 60 |
| Circle Business Elite | 0.00 | 40 | 60 | 100 | 150 |

## Boundary readings of the delivery threshold

The threshold is expressed as an order value at or above which standard delivery is free, so the figure
itself qualifies. On Circle Plus Annual, whose threshold is 199.00, a hypothetical order valued at
199.00 qualifies and one valued at 198.99 does not. On Circle Free Membership, whose threshold is
499.00, the same pair of hypothetical orders falls the other way: neither qualifies, and an order of
499.00 is the lowest that does. Where the threshold is recorded as 0.00 — Circle Total Annual, Circle
Total Household Annual, Circle Business Pro and Circle Business Elite — no order value falls below it.

Haul-away inclusions and the restocking waiver do not move together with the threshold: Circle Business
Pro includes 12 haul-aways a year but waives only 50 percent of a restocking fee, while Circle Total
Annual includes 4 and waives 100 percent.
